focus: Comprehensive when-not-to-use boundary matrix plus rollback, shadow/canary, kill switches, failure observability, old-contract consumers, and projection-disablement-versus-authority-change rules for P1-P7
noveltyJustification: Iteration 18 supplied schemas and staged adoption; this pass adds the operational decision matrix for every P contract, separates projection disablement, promotion abort, and authority rollback, binds rollback and canary behavior to 036, inventories retained old-contract consumers, and defines failure observability without authority leakage.
keyFindings: Projection disablement, promotion abort, and selected-authority rollback require three distinct controls
P1 and P2 use consumer-scoped advisory fallback while preserving authority state and epoch
P3 blocks promotion or requests governed rollback but never actuates authority
P4 P5 and P7 canary one reversible protected mutation surface and never permissively fall back after cutover
P6 local fallback is legal only while additive; safety-dependent consumers fail closed on absent or unknown refusal semantics
Old-contract readers writers adapters fixtures and telemetry are retained rollback assets until independent retirement gates pass
Failure observability may quarantine freeze or request rollback but only governed routing or authority CAS changes behavior

ruledOut.approach: Use one graph-wide enable or kill switch
ruledOut.reason: It conflates advisory projections parity evidence writers truth admission refusals human gates and effects with different authority boundaries

ruledOut.approach: Fallback directly to a legacy writer after selected-authority failure
ruledOut.reason: Without admission freeze epoch advancement fencing and reconciliation this creates split brain

ruledOut.approach: Let shadow or canary results move authority
ruledOut.reason: Parity is evidence for a certificate and never an authority actuator

ruledOut.approach: Canary the whole P1-P7 stack at once
ruledOut.reason: Independent projection writer truth human and effect risks need separately reversible units

ruledOut.approach: Disable P6 permissively after control consumers depend on it
ruledOut.reason: Unknown refusal semantics must fail closed and cannot become success or executable advice

ruledOut.approach: Retire legacy readers when writers stop
ruledOut.reason: Historical packets decisions receipts and approvals require exact-version replay through archival gates

ruledOut.approach: Let alerts refusals choices checkpoints or certificates authorize transitions
ruledOut.reason: Observability and evidence can block or request action but carry no mutation or effect authority

nextFocus: Terminal completeness audit: unresolved contradictions, decision conflicts, and synthesis-ready verdicts

summary: Projection disablement, promotion abort, and selected-authority rollback are three separate control classes.
inference: Distinct switch discriminants prevent a local projection fault from impersonating an authority transition.

summary: P1 and P2 need consumer-scoped fallback identities rather than a graph-wide flag.
inference: A consumer manifest is the minimum auditable routing unit for advisory fallback.

summary: P3 is a promotion gate and rollback sensor but never an authority actuator.
inference: Parity outcomes can invalidate evidence or request governed action, not perform the authority CAS.

summary: P4, P5, and P7 canaries must isolate one reversible protected mutation surface.
inference: One-resource or one-edge canaries preserve causal diagnosis and independent rollback.

summary: P6 may fall back locally only while it remains additive; safety-dependent consumers fail closed on absent or unknown semantics.
inference: A schema dependency converts presentation fallback into a safety dependency.

summary: Old-contract consumers are retained rollback assets until their own zero-use and archival-read gates pass.
inference: Writer retirement and reader retirement are independent lifecycle decisions.

summary: Failure observability blocks, freezes, or requests action but does not itself grant mutation or effect authority.
inference: Observability-to-action remains an explicitly authorized boundary.
